title: sqlite-mcp: Read-only mode bypass via statement chaining and SQL injection in describe_table (CVE-2026-130008)
description: sqlite-mcp versions prior to 0.1.2 allow bypassing read-only mode protections via statement chaining in execute_query and SQL injection in describe_table. This enables unauthorized write access to databases intended to be read-only, reading arbitrary SQLite files, and creating new SQLite files where the server process can write. The server lacks built-in authentication and listens on all interfaces by default, increasing exposure risk. The issue is fixed in version 0.1.2 by disabling ATTACH, enforcing query-only mode, rejecting multi-statement queries, and parameterizing inputs.
